title: Mali SOUVANNALATH (mother)
description: Persona, from the WHO guide's QR Code Generation section 12 example (the guardian, gn). A Lao national, 29, resident with her family in Country B (home; fictional GDHCN DEV participant XXH), who gave birth while visiting relatives in Country A (XXR, the birth country). Reads Lao and some English; one Android phone shared by the family; keeps paper documents in a plastic sleeve. Wants her daughter's vaccinations to count at home without repeating them, and does not want to manage passwords for each child. Fictional.
